description: Manage customer invoices for the authenticated business Team in full MCP clients. List invoices and owner accounting books, create or edit drafts, get details, create a secure share link, email an invoice after explicit recipient confirmation, or delete a draft after explicit confirmation. Stripe/PayStack/PayFast checkout happens only on the customer portal; this tool cannot execute, simulate, or mark a payment. The administrator can disable Team invoicing, email, gateways, or this MCP surface independently.

book_id.description: create_invoice: accounting book ID returned by list_invoices

confirm.description: Required true for delete_invoice and send_invoice_email, only after the user confirms the deletion or recipient

customer_email.description: create/update: customer email used for email and gateway checkout

customer_id.description: create/update: accounting customer ID; omit to find/create by email

invoice_id.description: Required except for list_invoices and create_invoice

owner_id.description: Workers linked to multiple teams: owner/team ID returned by list_invoices

payment_provider.description: create/update: customer checkout provider allowed by the selected business; omit to disable online payment

team_id.description: Business Team ID returned by manage_business_teams action=list_teams

worker_id.description: Owner only: linked worker account ID to assign, or omit for unassigned

name: manage_team_invoices
